title: The Deity of the Holy Spirit
definition: The deity of the Holy Spirit means that the Holy Spirit is fully God, sharing the divine nature, glory, authority, and attributes of the Father and the Son.
summary: The Holy Spirit is not an impersonal force or created power. Scripture speaks of Him as God, showing divine knowledge, presence, holiness, authority, and power.
christFocus: The Holy Spirit glorifies Christ and points believers to Him. He applies the saving work of Christ and helps believers know, worship, and follow Jesus.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Holy Spirit is not an impersonal force or created power. Scripture speaks of Him as God, showing divine knowledge, presence, holiness, authority, and power.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
